heading: top-center
name: 置中標題＋附序號與圖片的項目輪播
desc: 標題組置中在上方，下方是一次露出四個項目的輪播；每個項目有大號序號、一張橫式圖片、標題與按鈕，下方有箭頭與頁碼。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組；標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字，沒有時省略。標題組下方是多個項目的橫向輪播，對齊頁面內容寬度，一次露出四個等寬的項目，邊緣不露出下一個。每個項目無外框，元素靠左：最上方是大號序號，約為標題的一倍半到兩倍大；下方是一張橫式圖片，橫跨項目寬度；圖片下方是標題（可多行），接著一列左側小標籤、右側靠右的次要文字，再下方是說明文字與按鈕；小標籤、次要文字、說明文字可省略，沒有時省略，其他元素的位置不變。輪播下方置中放一列切換控制：中間是頁碼（目前頁與總頁數之間以一條短線相連），左箭頭按鈕與右箭頭按鈕分在頁碼兩側，和頁碼之間隔一段明顯的距離，三者不擠在一起；點箭頭一次切換一整組，不自動播放。
tablet: 平板沿用桌機版，一次露出的項目數減少。
mobile: 輪播一次露出一個項目，右側邊緣露出下一個項目的一部分；輪播左側對齊頁面內容寬度，右側延伸到畫面右緣。項目內部結構不變。標題組仍在上方置中。下方切換控制保留：左右箭頭分在兩側，頁碼置中，改為一次切換一個項目。

en.name: Centered heading + carousel of numbered items with an image
en.desc: A centered heading group on top, followed by a carousel showing four items at a time; each item has a large number, a single landscape image, a title and a button, with arrows and a page counter below.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description below; omit them when there is no content. Below the heading group is a horizontal carousel of multiple items, aligned to the page content width, showing four items of equal width at a time, with no part of the next item visible at the edge. Each item has no frame and its elements are aligned left: at the top is a large number, about one and a half to two times the size of the title; below it is a single landscape image spanning the width of the item; below the image is a title (may wrap to multiple lines), then a row with a label on the left and secondary text aligned right, then a description and a button. The label, secondary text and description are optional; omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements. Below the carousel, centered, place a row of controls: a page counter in the middle (the current page and the total pages joined by a short line), with a left arrow button and a right arrow button on either side of it, separated from the page counter by a clear distance, so the three are not packed together as one group; clicking an arrow switches a whole set at a time, with no autoplay.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout, with fewer items visible at a time.
en.mobile: The carousel shows one item at a time, with part of the next item visible at the right edge; the carousel's left side is aligned to the page content width and its right side extends to the right edge of the screen. The internal structure of each item is unchanged. The heading group stays at the top, centered. The controls below are kept: the left and right arrows sit at the two sides and the page counter is centered, and it now switches one item at a time.
